title: Bharatvarshar Buranji (ভাৰতবৰ্ষৰ বুৰঞ্জী - ২য় সংস্কৰণ)
author: Sahityarathi Lakshminath Bezbaroa (লক্ষ্মীনাথ বেজবৰুৱা)
description: Historical chronicle and comparative historiographical account of India by the pioneer of modern Assamese literature, Lakshminath Bezbaroa. The work places the distinct indigenous kingdoms of the Brahmaputra valley—notably the Tai-Ahom sovereign state—within the wider continental historical narrative.
source: Guwahati: Lawyer's Book Stall, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.452534

sentences.lik_tai: ပပ်ႉ ၼႆႉ ပဵၼ် လိၵ်ႈ ပိုၼ်း ဢၼ် သႃႇႁိတ်ႉယႃႇရႃႇထီႇ လၵ်ႉသ်မီႇၼႃႇထ် ပေတ်းပရုဝႃႇ တႅမ်ႈဝႆႉ
sentences.text_roman: pap nai pen lik poen an sa hit ya ra thi lak smi na th pet pa ru wa taem wai
